+from collections import UserDict
+from collections.abc import Iterator, MutableMapping
 from typing import Any
 
 import anyio
@@ -294,14 +295,37 @@ def test_request_state_object() -> None:
 
     s = State(scope["state"])
 
+    assert isinstance(s, MutableMapping)
+    assert s["old"] == "foo"
+
     s.new = "value"
     assert s.new == "value"
+    assert s["new"] == "value"
+
+    s["another"] = "item"
+    assert s.another == "item"
+    assert list(s) == ["old", "new", "another"]
+    assert len(s) == 3
 
     del s.new
+    del s["another"]
 
     with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
         s.new
 
+    assert dict(s) == {"old": "foo"}
+
+
+def test_request_state_preserves_mutable_mapping() -> None:
+    state: UserDict[str, Any] = UserDict({"old": "foo"})
+    scope: Scope = {"type": "http", "state": state}
+
+    request = Request(scope)
+    request.state.new = "value"
+
+    assert request.state._state is state
+    assert state == {"old": "foo", "new": "value"}
+
